module_title: CKA Week 6 - Storage, Helm, Kustomize and Extension Points
title: CKA Week 6 Challenge - Storage, Helm, Kustomize, CRDs
description: End-of-week challenge for the smaller exam domains: static and dynamic volumes, a stuck PVC to fix, Helm lifecycle, a Kustomize overlay and a custom resource definition.
scenario: Week 6 in one lab. k3s ships the local-path provisioner and a ready-made Helm chart plus Kustomize base wait for you in /root. A deliberately broken PVC tests your debugging.
symptoms: pending-pvc references a StorageClass that does not exist - fix it to local-path
The chart in /root/webchart defaults to nginx:1.27; overrides come via --set
The Kustomize base in /root/kustomize/base deploys cka-web at 1 replica
mission: Bind static and dynamic volumes, expand a StorageClass, rescue a stuck PVC, run a full Helm lifecycle (install/upgrade/rollback/template) and ship an overlay with Kustomize, then extend the API with a CRD.

hints.title: Static vs dynamic binding
hints.content: manual-pvc binds only because storageClassName matches the PV. dyn-pvc relies on the local-path provisioner. A PVC binds on capacity + accessModes + className matching.

hints.title: RWO vs RWOP
hints.content: ReadWriteOnce = one NODE at a time; ReadWriteOncePod = one POD. Do not mix them - the exam loves this distinction.

hints.title: Helm lifecycle order
hints.content: install --set replicaCount=2 (rev 1), upgrade --set image.tag=1.28 (rev 2), rollback 1 (rev 3). helm history shows every revision; get values shows the live ones.

hints.title: Kustomize patches
hints.content: The overlay needs: resources [../../base], a replicas patch (target kind Deployment), images: [{name: nginx, newTag: 1.28}] and namespace: w6. kubectl apply -k does the rest.

acceptance_criteria.description: PVC manual-pvc is Bound to manual-pv
Pod pvc-user mounts manual-pvc at /usr/share/nginx/html and runs
Dynamic PVC dyn-pvc (1Gi, storageClassName local-path) is Bound
Rescue: seeded pending-pvc (bad StorageClass) is now Bound
StorageClass fast: local-path provisioner, Retain, allowVolumeExpansion
Helm release webapp installed in w6 with replicaCount 2
Helm rollback executed (history shows a Rollback entry)
helm template output saved to /root/chart-render.yaml (Deployment + ConfigMap)
Kustomize overlay prod applied: cka-web at 3 replicas on nginx:1.28
CRD databases.example.com Established + CR my-db with spec.size=small
